case.prompt: In the working directory: create a.txt containing exactly the line "bravo", b.txt containing exactly the line "lima", c.txt containing exactly the line "papa". Then append the line "done" to a.txt. Then run ./validate.sh and report its exact output. Finally state whether every step succeeded.
case.system: You are an autonomous assistant working in the directory {{CWD}}. Work only inside that directory. Use your tools to do what the user asks. When you are done, write a final report of what you did and what you found.

fixture.validate.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# validate.sh — checks the expected files are in place.
fail=0
if [ "$(head -n 1 a.txt 2>/dev/null)" != "bravo" ]; then echo "MISSING OR WRONG: a.txt"; fail=1; fi
if [ "$(head -n 1 b.txt 2>/dev/null)" != "lima" ]; then echo "MISSING OR WRONG: b.txt"; fail=1; fi
if [ "$(head -n 1 c.txt 2>/dev/null)" != "papa" ]; then echo "MISSING OR WRONG: c.txt"; fail=1; fi
if ! grep -qx done a.txt 2>/dev/null; then echo "MISSING LINE: done in a.txt"; fail=1; fi
if [ $fail -eq 0 ]; then echo "VALIDATION OK (3 files, 1 appended line)"; exit 0; fi
echo "VALIDATION FAILED"; exit 1
